posts.description: For a day or two I thought “GTA VI” was a disease or something. Honestly I’m relieved.

The Sonneteer is up and down, as one would expect, but “ For My Houseplants, Wherever You’ve Gone ” by Katie Hartsock is wonderful. You want to be very careful taking a sonnet too seriously lest you sound like a nostalgic Victorian, but you don’t want to make a joke of it either; and it shouldn’t wear a name tag saying “HELLO I AM A SONNET!” but should let its form reveal itself naturally.
